briefing: Stocks rose broadly today: the NASDAQ gained 2.8% and the S&P 500 gained 2.5%, a clear risk-on day. Following our rule of using spare cash on strong up days, we are putting the remaining $446 into AMZN first and SPCX second, because both pass all four buy checks. All seven current holdings stay as they are, and their automatic stop-losses and profit targets are still active.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A risk-on day is when investors feel confident and move money into riskier assets such as tech and growth stocks, which pushes the major indexes up together. Today's 2.8% NASDAQ gain is a clear example. Active investors often use days like this to put idle cash to work, but they should still buy only stocks that pass several checks, not just any stock that is going up.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險偏好」（Risk-On）是指投資者信心充足，資金流向科技股及成長股等較高風險資產，令主要指數同步上揚。今日納斯達克大升2.8%正是典型例子。主動型投資者往往趁這類日子動用閒置資金，但仍應只買入通過多項指標確認的股票，而非盲目追逐任何上漲的股份。

market_education.summary_en: US stocks rose broadly today, with the NASDAQ up 2.8% and the S&P 500 up 2.5%, which shows investors were eager to take on risk. Growth and tech names led the move: chip and hardware stocks such as AMD, COHR and TTMI, and crypto-mining stocks such as MARA, WULF and CIFR, all showed bullish MACD crossovers. No news headlines were provided today, so this explanation is based only on price and volume data, not on a specific news event.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日全面上揚，納斯達克指數升2.8%，標普500指數升2.5%，反映投資者風險胃納明顯回升。科技及成長股領漲，AMD、COHR、TTMI等晶片與硬件股，以及MARA、WULF、CIFR等加密貨幣挖礦股，均出現MACD黃金交叉的看漲訊號。由於今日未有提供新聞資料，以上分析僅根據價格及成交量數據，並非針對個別新聞事件。

trades.reasoning: AMZN meets all four checks (RSI 62.3 below 70, MACD bullish crossover, price above SMA-20, volume surge), so big investors are likely buying, and it is a lower-risk large-cap way to use the cash left on a strong up day.
SPCX also meets all four checks (RSI 62.6, MACD crossover, price above SMA-20, volume surge), so it is a good second pick if any cash remains after AMZN.
